Optional: local MapLibre 6.13.0 files to avoid CDN dependency.
Download the matching files from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maplibre-gl@6.13.0/dist/ :
maplibre-gl.mjs
maplibre-gl-shared.mjs
maplibre-gl-worker.mjs
maplibre-gl.css
Place each directly in THIS folder and upload on GitHub. Include MapLibre BSD-3-Clause license from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maplibre-gl@6.13.0/LICENSE.txt .
GitHub Pages will serve the files directly, no GitHub Actions required.
Without local files, the app tries public CDNs. Network is still necessary for OpenStreetMap tiles.
